title: AIVale workspace lifecycle write contract 1.0.0
description: P01-T04 adds only API-002/004/005. Existing workspace read and probe/core schemas remain unchanged. Request decoding adds source-level checks beyond JSON Schema.

x-contract.authentication: Existing explicit Bearer dashboard session only; no cookie fallback; PAT/model tokens rejected.

requests.query: none, including an empty query marker
requests.strict_json: One object only; exact field names; reject unknown, duplicate decoded keys at every depth, null, invalid UTF-8 and unpaired Unicode surrogates.
requests.slug: Optional on create; if supplied, canonical lowercase ASCII 1..64 with no trim/lower conversion.
requests.expected_revision: Canonical positive JSON source integer, 1..9007199254740991; no float/exponent/string/null.

idempotency.key_characters: Visible ASCII 0x21..0x7e; exactly one header value; no trim.
idempotency.expires_at_unit: UTC Unix milliseconds as canonical positive decimal string
idempotency.expired_key_behavior: No cleanup/reuse in this release: same request still returns stored receipt after live authorization; different request remains 409. Expiry does not allow a new side effect.
idempotency.replay: Creation and archive return the original immutable receipt; authorization is checked again. An archived create target is not replayable. Archive replay can use the archived target only while current management permission remains.
idempotency.patch: No key required; expected_revision CAS controls updates.

x-contract.archive: Pre-runtime only: active_run_count must be zero. If ag_runs/ag_schedules/ag_schedule_fires tables exist, archive is unavailable until the corresponding domain adapters are implemented. No run/schedule draining or stopped-schedule count is claimed.
x-contract.errors: Fixed shared envelope only; no current_revision or blocking count inside error data.

name.description: Raw input must be valid UTF-8 without NUL and at most 128 code points / 512 bytes, then trim surrounding Unicode whitespace and require a nonempty result.

description.description: Valid UTF-8 without NUL, at most 4096 bytes; preserve surrounding whitespace. Empty string clears the description.

expected_revision.description: The JSON source token must contain only canonical positive decimal digits; strings, fractions, exponent notation and null are rejected before conversion. JSON Schema alone cannot verify numeric source spelling.
